annotations.title: List Snap Pixels on a Snapchat ad account

description: The Snap Pixels on a Snapchat ad account — id, name and status. A conversion ad squad (optimizationGoal PIXEL_PAGE_VIEW, PIXEL_ADD_TO_CART, PIXEL_PURCHASE or PIXEL_SIGNUP) optimises toward a pixel, so call this first and pass the pixelId to create_snapchat_ads_ad_squad. A pixel is made in Snapchat Ads Manager (Events Manager) and installed on the site; Snapchat publishes no API that creates one. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared
